title: Kroma Studio
summary: An editorial digital storefront for a Scandinavian lighting and furniture studio with fluid transitions.
overview: Kroma Studio required an online presence that translates the physical presence and precision of architectural lighting into an interactive digital space. The goal was an uncompromising shopping experience that prioritises visual calmness, editorial pace, and seamless page transitions without distracting cart friction.

thumbnail.alt: Minimalist interior with warm directional studio lighting and sculptural furniture

hero.alt: Architectural modern interior highlighting Kroma's flagship lighting series

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: Traditional e-commerce templates separate storytelling from shopping: an editorial lookbook on one page, a cluttered grid of square product thumbnails on another. Kroma needed their products to live inside architectural contexts without sacrificing checkout efficiency or conversion clarity.

image.alt: Detail view of brushed aluminium fixture and ambient illumination

sections.caption: Plate 01 · Product material detail and contextual illumination.

sections.heading: The approach
sections.body: We treated each product page as an architectural spread. GSAP-driven shared element transitions smoothly elevate product plates from the catalogue into immersive configuration screens. The cart stays completely invisible until triggered, maintaining total editorial stillness.

images.alt: Atmospheric lamp lighting warm wooden living room
Hanging pendant lamp in modern concrete studio
Overhead view of minimalist dining space

desktop.alt: Desktop and mobile multi-device viewport rendering

items.name: Headless Storefront
items.note: Shopify Storefront GraphQL backend with static React prerendering on Vercel Edge.

items.name: Shared Plate Transitions
items.note: GPU-accelerated GSAP Flip morphing catalogue plates into product heroes with zero layout shifts.

items.name: Predictive Prefetching
items.note: Preloading high-resolution product imagery and chunks on hover for instant navigation.

items.challenge: Rendering high-resolution architectural imagery without slowing mobile initial paint.
items.response: Implemented multi-tier AVIF generation and prioritized font rendering ahead of secondary viewport images.

items.challenge: Maintaining accessible screen-reader navigation across custom animated product plates.
items.response: Decoupled presentational GSAP animation layers from standard semantic anchor links and live regions.

sections.body: A fast, quiet, and deeply tactile shopping experience that increased direct checkout completion while establishing Kroma's brand as an international design benchmark.

title: Aether Health
summary: A calm, accessible clinical portal for remote specialist consultations and patient biomarker tracking.
overview: Aether Health rethinks clinical software by replacing complex, dense dashboards with a calming, highly structured interface engineered for both physicians and anxious patients.

thumbnail.alt: Clean medical clinic with modern diagnostic workstation and soft natural light

hero.alt: Aether clinical intelligence interface displayed on workstation

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: Healthcare software is notorious for cognitive overload. Clinicians spend more time navigating confusing tables and nested menus than reviewing critical patient signals. Aether required an interface that communicates urgency without inciting panic.

image.alt: Close up of patient monitoring equipment interface and tactile dials

sections.heading: The approach
sections.body: We engineered an asymmetric 12-column layout that prioritises diagnostic timelines. Using strict tabular typography and deliberate spatial hierarchy, complex medical metrics are readable at a single glance with zero ambiguous charts.

items.name: Dynamic Consultation Room
items.note: WebRTC encrypted video integrated with live synchronized health charts.

items.name: Keyboard-First Triage
items.note: Complete keyboard navigation and hotkeys designed for high-throughput clinicians.

items.name: High-Contrast Verification
items.note: WCAG 2.2 AAA text and non-text contrast conformance throughout all clinical views.

sections.body: Deployed to over 40 specialized clinics, reducing clinical note entry time by 34% while maintaining 100% positive patient usability feedback.

title: Forma Architecture
summary: A brutalist monograph website documenting civic infrastructure projects across Tokyo and Zurich.
overview: Forma Architecture designs heavy civic infrastructure and cultural buildings. Their digital portfolio was conceived as a physical publication rendered in the browser, featuring large-scale grotesk typography and unadorned structural imagery.

thumbnail.alt: Raw concrete architectural facade with sharp geometric shadows

hero.alt: Dramatic geometric skyscraper rising into overcast sky

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: Architecture studio portfolios often rely on carousel gimmicks or tiny image thumbnails that fail to convey the scale, material weight, and physical presence of large-scale civic buildings.

image.alt: Full bleed perspective of cantilevered concrete pavilion

sections.heading: The approach
sections.body: We stripped away all decorative chrome. Oversized typography anchors each project in raw structural hairlines, and scroll-driven image unveils treat each building photograph as a heavy architectural plate.
Honoured by international architecture and design juries as an exemplary synthesis of digital publishing craft and physical architecture.

title: Veloce Mobility
summary: An ultra-lean, high-precision launch page for next-generation urban electric mobility platforms.
overview: Veloce required a launch page that communicates lightweight velocity and aerospace precision. The resulting product is an ultra-fast, responsive interactive presentation that demonstrates aerodynamic efficiency through motion.

thumbnail.alt: Precision engineered matte black electric motorcycle chassis

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: Product landing pages frequently suffer from excessive 3D asset weight, causing 5-second load times on mobile devices and high bounce rates from prospective investors and early adopters.

sections.caption: Plate 04 · Structural chassis engineering and wind telemetry.

sections.body: Achieved a 99 Lighthouse performance rating with a 1.2s First Contentful Paint, driving over 12,000 pre-orders in the first 48 hours.

title: Lumina AI
summary: An intelligent spatial computing canvas for real-time generative workflow orchestration and audio-reactive visualization.
overview: Lumina AI unifies node-based workflow scripting and conversational intelligence into a zero-latency spatial canvas designed for creative technologists and generative engineers.

thumbnail.alt: Prismatic 3D gradient sculpture with deep luminescent refraction

hero.alt: Abstract spatial fluid dynamics simulation in deep slate

sections.heading: The challenge
sections.body: Orchestrating multi-modal generative models requires continuous visual context. Traditional chat interfaces force users into linear scrolls, hiding previous prompt-response branches.
Created an infinite zoomable workspace rendering 120 FPS node graphs with zero GPU throttling on standard laptops.

title: Strata Treasury
summary: Next-generation institutional treasury workstation providing real-time multi-currency settlement and liquidity telemetry.
overview: Strata Treasury replaces legacy banking portals with a low-latency, mission-critical operations dashboard engineered for institutional asset managers and corporate treasury desks.

thumbnail.alt: Dark iridescent cryptographic geometry with amber edge highlights

hero.alt: Decentralized liquidity topology rendered in dark amber tones

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: Institutional corporate treasuries manage hundreds of cross-border payment rails across disconnected banking consoles, causing reconciliation lag and liquidity opacity.
Delivered an institutional-grade terminal with sub-second WebSocket updates processing over $4B in monthly settlement volume.

title: Aurora Finance
summary: An institutional wealth management cockpit delivering real-time asset allocation telemetry and high-velocity trade analytics.
overview: Aurora Finance replaces sluggish legacy wealth portals with a hyper-responsive, dark-mode institutional operations terminal. Engineered for private wealth funds and asset management desks, it visualises cross-border portfolio rebalancing in real time.

thumbnail.alt: Aurora Finance institutional wealth management terminal with real-time portfolio telemetry

hero.alt: Aurora Finance digital asset management overview with fluid charts

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: Legacy wealth portals struggle with slow load times, confusing table structures, and lack of visual clarity for cross-asset portfolios.
Engineered an instant, sub-second portfolio cockpit delivering 45% faster execution and modern asset allocation clarity.

title: Meridian Law
summary: An austere, typography-driven digital monograph for an international arbitration and corporate law practice.
overview: Meridian Law strips away generic corporate fluff in favour of monolithic Swiss typography, razor-sharp grid hairlines, and restrained editorial pacing tailored for global sovereign advisory.

thumbnail.alt: Meridian Law editorial monograph layout in dark monolithic tones

hero.alt: Architectural law boardroom in stark monochrome lighting

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: International dispute practices often suffer from bloated, interchangeable stock-photo websites that fail to communicate gravity, prestige, and discretion.
Established a distinct, award-winning editorial aesthetic that elevated partner client acquisition by 80% across European and US chambers.

title: Halo Collective
summary: An immersive spatial showreel and dynamic interactive archive for a global multidisciplinary creative studio.
overview: Halo Collective synthesises real-time WebGL distortions, physics-based typography, and interactive audio feedback into a fluid visual journey celebrating cutting-edge commercial cinema and brand worlds.

thumbnail.alt: Halo Collective futuristic cyber-spatial showreel interface

hero.alt: Halo Collective luminous volumetric typography and neon highlights

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: Creative studios need their portfolio to feel as daring and technologically advanced as the films, games, and identities they produce.
Crafted a 60fps WebGL showreel experience nominated for Site of the Year with over 250K global developer impressions.
